details:
TLDR; you can cause this with a keyboard in
https://vrchat.net/launch?worldId=wrld_cbc74775-afe7-4c34-9778-bea896bfdf07
By pressing Shift + [ to send a curly bracket.

The VRC_EventHandler will output an exception in the logs and stop handling the event if there are curly brackets in them.

For example, call your GameObject "Key{" and send *any* event to see an exception like this.
